description: A publisher host declares explicit publish routes and a consumer host declares listener bindings. The criterion is universal over both hosts and both satisfy it in their own role. This is the shape a live run refused over a branch that carried it. It also carries one genuinely unmet criterion, so the same delivery exercises both directions of the score.

criteria.text: Each applicable host contains an explicit broker extension with conventional local routing disabled, explicit publish routes where the host publishes, and listener bindings where the host consumes.
criteria.because: Sample.Server declares DisableConventionalLocalRouting and two PublishMessage routes; Sample.Worker declares DisableConventionalLocalRouting, a queue binding and a listener. A consumer having no publish route is the topology its role requires.

criteria.text: Every publish route names its exchange through the shared name formatter rather than a literal string.
criteria.because: Both publish routes pass literal strings to ToExchange; no formatter is called anywhere in the branch.
